runs.t: Gus the pup was in the mud.
He dug in the mud and got a bug.
Gus ran to the rug with his bug.
Mum sees Gus on the rug.
“No Gus! No bugs on the rug!”
Mum jumps up to stop Gus, but he is fast.
Mum grabs Gus and dumps him in the tub.
